entities.name: Oboro
entities.description: Main cloud palace of the Soratami in Otawara, sacred ground forbidden to non-moonfolk.

entities.name: Sakashima
entities.description: Human disguise-genius, one of the only non-Soratami to set foot in Oboro.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Ronin kanji mage who set foot in Oboro.

entities.name: Kiki-Jiki
entities.description: Famed Akki wizard, Mirror Breaker, who set foot in Oboro.

events.summary: After damage in the New Phyrexian Invasion, Oboro's treasures are temporarily moved to a guarded stronghold.
events.quote: many of its treasures were temporarily moved to a heavily guarded stronghold

relations.quote: located in the city of Otawara
